request.prompt:
Goods: Upholstered office chair, steel base
Country of origin: CN

Chosen so far: 94 Furniture; bedding, mattresses, mattress supports, cushions and similar stuffed furnishings; lamps and lighting fittings, n.e.c.; illuminated signs, illuminated name-plates and the like; prefabricated buildings > 9401 Seats (not those of heading no. 9402), whether or not convertible into beds and parts thereof

Choose the subheading that covers these goods. Options:
- 940171: Seats; with metal frames, upholstered, (excluding medical, surgical, dental, veterinary or barber furniture)
- 940139: Seats; swivel with variable height adjustment of other than wood, excluding medical, surgical, dental, veterinary or barber furniture
- 940161: Seats; with wooden frames, upholstered, (excluding medical, surgical, dental, veterinary or barber furniture)
- 940131: Seats; swivel with variable height adjustment of wood, excluding medical, surgical, dental, veterinary or barber furniture
- 940179: Seats; with metal frames, not upholstered, (excluding medical, surgical, dental, veterinary or barber furniture)

Answer "none" if no option can cover these goods.

data.reason: The goods are an upholstered seat with a metal (steel) base. In HS 2022 the swivel height-adjustable subheadings (9401.31, 9401.39) come first, but the description does not say the chair swivels or adjusts, so the metal-framed upholstered subheading 9401.71 is the better fit.}
